title: Drowned Temple
summary: A flooded two-floor temple on the ocean floor. The Abyssal Herald, the Tidemother, and the gear made from Tide Pearls.

s.x: The Drowned Temple is a vast sunken temple of an older sea-faith, built on the ocean floor and flooded to the rafters. It has two floors of prismarine and sandstone halls, drowned guards with tridents, and a goddess of the deep at the bottom. It is the third dungeon, and the first where the environment is part of the fight: you swim, you fight in water, and you hunt for the air pockets. Its boss, the
, drops the Tide Pearls for the Tidecaller Blade and the Tidemother Regalia.

s.x: At two thirds "the sea itself answers". At one third "the conduit overloads".

Move out of the ring when the warning reads "A tidal wave rises! Get clear!" or "The Tidemother raises her trident to crash down!". Hold your biggest attacks while "Coral armour sheathes the Tidemother", because the ward cuts her damage by 85%. The undertow drags you to her, so be ready for a slam right after it. In the last third, the storm of tridents is the danger, so keep strafing between volleys.
